title: Internal-node prescribed-GWL branch/snap boundary characterization
activation_dependency: GC-LOW01-B bounded KSATEXM-disabled inside-profile qualification must PASS before C1 execution is treated as evidence.

immutable_origin.rule: Each trial starts from the same provider-owned hydrostatic origin appropriate to its requested H_phreatic; no candidate is used as the origin of another trial.
immutable_origin.constitutive_scope: B110 default provider, KSATEXM disabled, identical to bounded LOW01-B.

gates: Every trial uses the same provider-owned constitutive route and no optional processes.
Observed/reconstructed active-node count and effective groundwater level match the frozen source algorithm exactly.
All trials return finite candidate pressure head, water content and diagnosed qbot without dt reduction or alternative solver.
Complete-profile mass residual closes within the LOW01-B 1e-10 cm gate for every trial.
Repeating every sweep point from its immutable origin is deterministic within the same O0/O2 and replay bounds as LOW01-B.
The test records qbot, storage, candidate-state and solver changes across the boundary; no continuity requirement is imposed prospectively.
required_outputs: effective H_phreatic after source snap rule
candidate hydraulic-state difference relative to AT_NODE
interpretation: A discontinuity at the source snap threshold is an observed property to characterize, not a test failure by itself.
C1 qualifies only internal-node branch/snap behavior.
The interval between bottom node centre and bottom face is explicitly excluded and remains LOW01-C2 policy work.
forbidden: do not execute before LOW01-B PASS
do not retune the four sweep points after observation
do not infer bottom-face branch semantics from C1
next_if_pass: Proceed with LOW01-D once A2 is qualified.
Resolve LOW01-C2 lower-half-cell policy separately before declaring HLINK04 envelope complete.
